about_the_game:
"Capture the fear. Earn the views."

As a livestreamer exploring a snow-covered forest, your goal is to document supernatural phenomena on camera.
Manage your stamina, hunger, and desire for validation, and push your limits in search of the perfect shot.
Gain followers, grow your channel, and uncover the hidden truth buried in the snow.

【Features】

📸 Capture supernatural events and turn them into views
Play from a first-person perspective and film ghostly phenomena.
Your shooting precision and distance affect the evaluation, and more views are earned with higher quality footage.
Longer recordings and closer encounters yield greater rewards, but also increase the danger.

🛌 A safe cabin and growth loop
Between excursions, return to your mountain cabin to rest, upload videos, buy items, and prepare for the next stream.
As your subscriber count grows, you’ll gain advantages in future sessions.

💀 Survival through resource management
Balance three key stats: Stamina, Validation (Motivation), and Hunger.
If stamina drops to zero, it’s game over. Letting hunger or motivation drop too low will accelerate stamina loss.

🌨️ Dynamic weather and cold
The weather alternates between normal and snowstorm conditions.
Blizzards increase difficulty but also raise the chance of rare supernatural events.

💬 Live chat reactions
Viewer comments appear in real-time during your streams, reacting dynamically to your situation.
They create an immersive atmosphere and amplify intense moments.

📺 A unique horror loop of shooting, streaming, and progression
This is not just a haunted hike—going viral might be your only way to survive.

You are free to stream, record, and upload gameplay videos of this game, including monetized content.

Feel free to share your experience with others!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10（64bit）
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580（6GB以上）
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p / 30fpsで安定動作を想定
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Play as a livestreamer exploring a snowy forest to capture supernatural events on camera. Manage stamina, hunger, and motivation while risking everything for views. The closer and longer you film, the more you earn. Upload videos, buy gear, and survive in this unique horror survival experience.
